units.scientificMeaning: Ten points down one straight line may follow an old fertilizer band, a drainage line or an equipment track. Many points along the same unusual feature can give a consistently biased picture. A route spread across the zone helps cover more of its variation; taking more soil from the same wrong strip does not solve the problem.

A systematic mismatch between collected material and the area or layer it is intended to represent.
